title: Zesty Velvety Croatian Egg Frittata
description: A spicy, velvety frittata that doubles as a hangover cure, featuring free-range eggs folded with roasted peppers, feta, and a splash of white wine, perfect for a vegetarian breakfast.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 20 cm non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add diced bell peppers and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with white wine, salt, pepper, and oregano in a bowl until fully blended.
Pour the egg mixture over the peppers, tilting the pan to spread evenly.
Sprinkle crumbled feta evenly across the surface.
Cook undisturbed for 4 minutes until the edges set but center remains slightly runny.
Gently lift and fold the edges toward the center, creating a loose crescent.
Finish cooking until the top is set and the frittata is lightly golden, about 3 more minutes; serve warm.
